contradiction_checks.check_label: Weather daily high temperature static comparison

known_limitations: Static local ledger only; no external refresh is performed.
Records mapped field differences and pending review state only.
Does not authorize execution and is not runtime input.
operator_review_steps: Confirm each source pair is copied from local static artifact references.
Confirm mapped fields and static values match the local artifact bytes.
Record unresolved differences outside this ledger before any later status change.

review_checks.description: Confirm source ids and source staleness rows match the local staleness spec.
Confirm source artifact references and digests match local bytes.
Confirm mapped field values are copied from local static artifacts.
Confirm every row remains pending operator review.
